content.text:
Set up and verified end-to-end:

- **`Cargo.toml`** — `winapi` pinned at `=0.3.9` with `winuser`/`libloaderapi`/`handleapi`/`fileapi` features, plus `winapi-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu = "=0.4.0"` scoped under `[target.x86_64-pc-windows-gnu.dependencies]` — that's the crate that supplies the MinGW-format `.a` import libraries the GNU toolchain needs (MSVC gets those from the Windows SDK instead).
- **`.cargo/config.toml`** — defaults the build target to `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` and points the linker at `x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc` (already present on this machine).
- **`src/main.rs`** — a small demo calling `GetModuleHandleW`/`MessageBoxW` to actually exercise the bindings, not just link them.

`cargo build` compiles cleanly and produces a genuine `PE32+ ... for MS Windows` executable. One side note: `rustup target list --installed` doesn't list `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` even though the std libs are already on disk and builds succeed — rustup's bookkeeping is stale, but it isn't blocking anything, so I left it alone.

Set up and verified end-to-end:

- **`Cargo.toml`** — `winapi` pinned at `=0.3.9` with `winuser`/`libloaderapi`/`handleapi`/`fileapi` features, plus `winapi-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu = "=0.4.0"` scoped under `[target.x86_64-pc-windows-gnu.dependencies]` — that's the crate that supplies the MinGW-format `.a` import libraries the GNU toolchain needs (MSVC gets those from the Windows SDK instead).
- **`.cargo/config.toml`** — defaults the build target to `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` and points the linker at `x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc` (already present on this machine).
- **`src/main.rs`** — a small demo calling `GetModuleHandleW`/`MessageBoxW` to actually exercise the bindings, not just link them.

`cargo build` compiles cleanly and produces a genuine `PE32+ ... for MS Windows` executable. One side note: `rustup target list --installed` doesn't list `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` even though the std libs are already on disk and builds succeed — rustup's bookkeeping is stale, but it isn't blocking anything, so I left it alone.
